data.narrative:
Tomorrow.io is a Series E-stage Space & Aerospace company that has raised $385M+ to date. Valuation analysis draws on a peer set of 5 public comps (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private companies including ICEYE, Rocket Lab, and Sierra Space at similar or adjacent funding stages.

Two triangulation methods proved applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.4x multiplier to the $385M total raised proxy, implying a $539M valuation. Peer-median anchoring uses three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage companies—ICEYE (Series F, $12.0B), Apex Space (Series D, $2.3B), and Varda Space Industries (Series D, $1.6B)—yielding a $2.3B median. The wide peer range ($1.6B–$12.0B) reflects stage and revenue heterogeneity within the Space & Aerospace sector. Public-comp anchoring via P/S multiple (median 27.4x across 6 tickers) cannot be applied due to unavailable revenue data for the target.

The two applicable methods triangulate to a $1.4B median valuation, with a $458M–$2.6B range. The lower bound anchors to stage-progression methodology, while the upper bound approaches peer medians. Key uncertainties include Tomorrow.io's actual revenue run rate and near-term growth trajectory relative to peers, which would sharpen multiples-based approaches once disclosed.
